name: Tue Kjærgaard Nielsen
role: Tenure Track Assistant Professor / Group Leader
bio:
Tue Kjærgaard Nielsen is a Tenure Track Assistant Professor at the Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences, University of Copenhagen. He is a molecular microbiologist specialising in microbial evolution and the role of mobile genetic elements.

### Research Focus
- PFAS Biodegradation: investigating microbial pathways for the degradation of PFAS and fluoride toxicity.
- Genomics & Bioinformatics: utilising 3rd generation sequencing (Nanopore) for genetic context analysis.
- Mobile Genetic Elements: studying the impact of MGEs and bacteriophages on microbial evolution.

### Background
Tue earned his PhD in Environmental Science from Aarhus University and has extensive experience in bioinformatic analysis of exotic DNA modifications and microbial ecology.
